title: Cut Features
description: Adds old features/ features that have been removed from the game!
body:
This mod adds some cool features that were removed! Some of the removed features included are...

**This Mod Includes:**
- Nether Wart Grows In Soul Sand Valleys (Legacy Console Edition Feature)
- C418 - [Dog Music Disc](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Dog_(song)) 
- [Cyan Flower](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Poppy#History) And [Rose](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Poppy#History)
- [Dirt Slab](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Dirt#History) For All Dirt Variants
- [Studded Armor](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Studded_Armor)
  - Copper Stud
-[Clay Blobs](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Clay_Blob) On Beaches
- [Copper Spleaves](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Copper_Spleaves)
- [Potone](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Potone) (snapshot [24w14potato](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_24w14potato) Feature)
- [Glowing Obsidian](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Glowing_Obsidian)

If you have any suggestions please comment/reply with them :)![a image shpwcasing the contents of the mod, this includes the Rose, Cyan Flower, Studded Chestplate, Nether Wart, Copper Spleave, Potone, and Glowing Obsidian Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc67cf9f44b2ab1c00af5ea349c43481f2993264.png)
